title: injuries reported after coach carrying school children crashes netherlands 2026 08 24
text:
AMSTERDAM, Aug 24 (Reuters) - A coach ‌carrying high-school students from Germany crashed in the east of the Netherlands ​early on Monday, injuring eight ​people, who were taken to hospital, ⁠Dutch police said.
"Some of the ​victims taken to the hospital ​are seriously injured," the police department of Gelderland province said in a post on ​X. Other people suffered minor ​injuries in the accident.
The coach, which carried ‌more ⁠than 50 people, according to a police spokesperson, crashed near the town of Wezep, some 100 ​km (62 miles) ​east of ⁠Amsterdam around 4 a.m. (0200 GMT) due to a ​collision with a delivery van, ​whose ⁠driver was among the injured victims.
The A28 highway was closed in ⁠both ​directions following the ​accident.
